description: This file defines the 'Project' result class for the Coocook schema, including database table mapping, relationships, and methods for project management such as archiving, inventory calculation, and permission checks.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Project
classes.description: A class representing the 'projects' table in the database, with methods for project lifecycle, relationships, and data retrieval.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Marks the project as archived by setting the 'archived' timestamp to current time.

methods.name: unarchive
methods.description: Removes the archived status from the project.

methods.name: articles_cached_units
methods.description: Fetches articles and units related to the project, caching their relationships for efficient access.

methods.name: dish_ingredients
methods.description: Shortcut method to retrieve ingredients related to dishes in the project.

methods.name: inventory
methods.description: Returns a hashref with counts of various related objects within the project.

methods.name: is_stale
methods.description: Determines if the project is considered stale based on a pivot date, indicating if it can be archived.

methods.name: find_or_create_tags_from_names
methods.description: Finds existing tags or creates new ones based on provided names.

methods.name: organizations_without_permission
methods.description: Returns organizations not associated with the project.

methods.name: other_projects
methods.description: Returns all projects except the current one.

methods.name: unit_conversion_graph
methods.description: Returns the unit conversion graph for the project.

methods.name: users_without_permission
methods.description: Returns users not associated with the project.
